notes: Nigeria ZIP = NIPOST 6-digit numeric code. First digit region (1–9), next two dispatch district, last three delivery location. Head office codes end in 001. On 1 Oct 2026 NIPOST launched 11-char National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode (NDAPS) per-building — 6-digit codes remain accepted on most forms; use 6-digit unless building asks for NDAPS. Every code quoted cites a public source; conflicting listings documented with note. Do not claim NIPOST endorsement.
